2014_subclasses.inquisitive.description: Inquisitives are specialist sleuths who use their knowledge of body language and psychology to detect lies and ferret out secrets. They are often employed by nobles, merchants, and law enforcement to investigate crimes and uncover the truth.
2014_subclasses.inquisitive.ear-for-dece: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you develop a keen ear for deception. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether someone is lying or to get a hunch about a person's manner, you can treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.
Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether someone is lying or to get a hunch about a person's manner, you can treat a d20 roll of 7.
2014_subclasses.inquisitive.eye-for-deta: Starting at 3rd level, you can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden object or creature, or to make an Investigation check to uncover or decipher clues. In addition, you can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Insight) check to get a hunch about a person's manner.
Use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden object or creature, or to make an Investigation check.
2014_subclasses.inquisitive.insightful-f: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to read a foe's fighting style and exploit its weaknesses. As a bonus action, you can make a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by the target's Charisma (Deception) check. If you win the contest, you can use your Sneak Attack against that target even if you don't have advantage on the attack roll, but not if you have disadvantage. This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until you use this feature against a different creature.
Can use your Sneak Attack against that target even if you don't have advantage on the attack roll, but not if you have disadvantage. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.inquisitive.steady-eye.d: Starting at 9th level, you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Insight) check that relies on your sight when you, the target you are trying to observe, and your observer are all in the same plane of existence. In addition, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you are not moving.
2014_subclasses.inquisitive.steady-eye.s: You have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Insight) check that relies on your sight when you, the target you.
2014_subclasses.inquisitive.unerring-eye: At 13th level, your ability to read the intentions of others becomes nearly supernatural. As an action, you can sense the presence of shapechangers and anything that isn't in its original form, and you can detect the presence of illusions and other magic that masks the true form of a creature or object within 30 feet of you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Can sense the presence of shapechangers and anything that isn't in its original form, and you can detect the presence of illusions and other magic that masks the true form.
2014_subclasses.inquisitive.eye-for-weak: Starting at 17th level, you learn to exploit a creature's weaknesses by studying its tactics. While your Insightful Fighting feature applies to a creature, your Sneak Attack damage against that creature increases by 3d6.
Your Sneak Attack damage against that creature increases by 3d6.
